edges.reason: ifAdmin compares msg.sender to ADMIN to decide the privileged branch.
_willFallback requires msg.sender != ADMIN, restricting who may reach the delegation path.
The account parameter is hashed and compared inside isContract.
extcodehash result is assigned to the codehash local.
Empty account hash constant is stored in the accountHash local.
recipient is consumed as the target of the value transfer.
amount is consumed as the value of the transfer.
implementation is the delegatecall target in _delegate.
admin parameter is consumed by the constructor.
Constructor writes the immutable ADMIN state variable.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is sloaded by the overriding _implementation.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the sstore target in _setImplementation.
_logic is the caller supplied logic address verified and stored by initialize.
_data is the attacker controlled payload passed to the delegatecall.
data is the payload delegatecalled after the upgrade.
_logic is forwarded into _setImplementation by initialize.
newImplementation is the address written into storage by _setImplementation.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is copied into the local slot before the assembly write.
The boolean outcome of the raw call is captured in success.
The sloaded value is returned through the impl local variable.
The most derived _willFallback forwards execution to the admin-aware base implementation.
_fallback invokes the pre-fallback hook.
Admin-aware _willFallback calls super._willFallback.
ifAdmin gates the admin() getter on msg.sender == ADMIN.
ifAdmin gates the implementation() getter on msg.sender == ADMIN.
ifAdmin gates upgradeTo on msg.sender == ADMIN.
ifAdmin gates upgradeToAndCall on msg.sender == ADMIN.
The non-admin branch of ifAdmin routes to the proxy fallback.
upgradeTo delegates the storage write to _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall performs the upgrade through _upgradeTo.
_upgradeTo performs the write via _setImplementation.
_setImplementation requires Address.isContract(newImplementation) before writing.
initialize stores the first implementation through _setImplementation.
initialize executes the delegatecall with _data when payload length is non-zero.
upgradeToAndCall executes a delegatecall with data after upgrading.
_setImplementation performs the raw assembly sstore.
_delegate performs the assembly delegatecall.
_fallback calls _delegate with the resolved implementation.
sendValue issues the low-level value call.
The payable fallback routes uncontrolled calls to _fallback.
The delegatecall executes untrusted implementation code in the proxy storage context.
initialize delegatecalls caller supplied code, allowing reentrant state manipulation before completion.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the new implementation, which may reenter the proxy.
The raw value call to an arbitrary recipient can reenter sendValue before the success check.

normalization_plan.reason: account parameter exists only to feed the extcodehash check inside isContract.
recipient parameter is only used as the target of the unsafe value call.
amount parameter is only used as the value of the unsafe call.
implementation parameter is consumed solely as the delegatecall target in _delegate.
newImplementation parameter is only meaningful as the argument written by _setImplementation.
_logic parameter is validated and consumed entirely within initialize.
_data parameter exists only as the payload of the unsafe delegatecall.
admin parameter is only used to initialise the immutable state in the constructor.
data parameter exists only as the payload of the post-upgrade delegatecall.
codehash local is a temporary result inside isContract.
accountHash local is a constant comparison value local to isContract.
impl local is just the return carrier of _implementation.
slot local is only used to feed the assembly sstore.
success local captures the result of the unsafe call inside sendValue.
